::: {.remark .notes}

@cor-var-lincom2 is why two variables' [covariance](#def-cov) matters for combining them:
the covariance [term](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/algebra-sums.html#def-term) is what separates
the [variance](#def-variance) of their [sum](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/algebra-sums.html#def-summation)
from the sum of their variances,
and @cor-var-sum-indpt is the case where that term is 0.

:::
